title: SOSV Deep Tech Summit — Eric Ries and Steve Blank on how AI is changing the way startups are built
summary: SOSV's Deep Tech Summit runs free and virtual from 4 to 6 November, with 100 speakers across climate tech, human health and AI for the physical world. Eric appears alongside Steve Blank, who launched his Lean LaunchPad methodology at Stanford 15 years ago and has since rebuilt it around AI.
blockquote: Steve will be joining our 𝐒𝐎𝐒𝐕 𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡 𝐒𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐢𝐭 (Nov. 4-6) to discuss startups in the new AI era, alongside Eric Ries, author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible.
